title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种新的图表示学习模型——GSAERU，用于大规模时序图数据上的节点表征学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a new graph representation learning model, GSAERU, for node representation learning on large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 引入图摘要技术将原图映射到固定规模的新图中
通过图自编码器学习节点表征
将图摘要生成的节点表征聚合得到原图的节点表征
technical_features_en: Introduced graph summarization technology to map the original graph to a fixed-size new graph
Learned node representations using graph autoencoders
Aggregated node representations generated by graph summarization to obtain representations of the original graph

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN，用于分布式场景下的基于图神经网络的图表示学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN, for graph representation learning based on graph neural networks in distributed scenarios.
technical_features: 可以在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习
使用图摘要技术生成规模远小于原图的子图
领导节点负责同步更新GNN模型参数
technical_features_en: Performs mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes
Generates subgraphs much smaller than the original graph using graph summarization technology
The leader node is responsible for synchronously updating the GNN model parameters
